Choose and identity-verify the Development AI agent pool available in the current host before privileged worker dispatch.
Decide whether to apply recommended GitHub Rules; repository plan currently cannot expose rulesets without an eligible GitHub plan/public visibility.

notes: PHASE-000 foundation is complete and PHASE-001 development is active. WU-002 remains in progress because its acceptance criterion is not yet satisfied: approved desktop calling applications have not consumed processed/bypass audio through an installed OS-visible VSN virtual microphone. The verified Windows foundation includes Rust audio contracts and bounded queues, deterministic device selection/reselection, bounded stream recovery, IAudioClient3 planning, event-driven WASAPI capture, sample decode/reframing, CaptureRuntime reopen recovery, IMMNotificationClient delivery, bounded virtual-mic staging/output, Rust/C++ transport ABI, aligned Interlocked cursor publication, deterministic shared-region geometry, real user-mode section mapping and a WDK-buildable KMDF control driver with a secure driver-owned section lifecycle. The caller-supplied-section CONNECT assumption was replaced by driver-owned CONNECT v2 in merge 3953069f468c46d744f30625b3696e5b12f03a77. The KMDF control-driver slice merged as b2761ad400d92c1d810751fabcf4b071a40dfb9c. Protocol v2 then added an aligned per-slot seqlock stamp and guarded ConsumeOneRingFrame; AI Native run 34541120876 and Windows run 34541120903 passed before merge 9c57207482bdc20ca5dc70a06cbb43c0cfa86741. The PortCls/WaveRT descriptor slice established a build-valid 48 kHz mono 32-bit IEEE-float single-capture-stream descriptor set; AI Native run 34542011551 and Windows run 34542011553 passed before merge da1b0543bcbfe63ff6a342690cab3b250057bbe2. The PortCls lifecycle/WaveRT stream-contract slice added compile/link references to PcInitializeAdapterDriver and PcAddAdapterDevice while keeping StartDevice fail-closed with STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED; AI Native run 34543128712 and Windows run 34543128651 passed before merge 78ef04bf86bf02b25b9da25ef401dc84f73f0f2b. The WDF control-device experiment merged as f084e4be4d7930830ca68948699c26e42fc036c1 after AI Native run 34543962499 and Windows run 34543962515, but Microsoft KMDF miniport guidance later established that framework control-device objects are not valid for the intended PortCls miniport architecture. PR #18 was therefore closed unmerged and the architecture was corrected in merge 2665954315b52d01b3e59b6fb283f0da2a053eed. The corrected first implementation slice removes the unsupported WDF control-device source from the current build/tree and adds a raw WDM control-device scaffold. It links wdmsec.lib, calls IoCreateDeviceSecure with the VSN-specific class GUID A47B0129-C8DA-4A5E-B8C4-6D8E20AC37F2, SYSTEM + built-in Administrators SDDL and FILE_DEVICE_SECURE_OPEN, creates \Device\VsnVirtualMicControl plus \DosDevices\VsnVirtualMicControl, and provides bounded symbolic-link/device teardown. Its DRIVER_DISPATCH-typed CREATE/CLOSE/CLEANUP and DEVICE_CONTROL wrappers identify the exact VSN control PDEVICE_OBJECT and forward every non-control-device IRP to PortCls through PcDispatchIrp. CREATE and DEVICE_CONTROL on the control DO deliberately return STATUS_DEVICE_NOT_READY; the functions are not wired into the live DriverEntry. AI Native Quality Gates run 34545966880 and Windows Audio Validation run 34545966842 both passed on implementation head dbc33d15e7bcc7c0e540c96839ea501883838e54; Windows passed Rust compile/Clippy/tests, pinned WDK restore, .sys build/WDK validation and the native C++ suite. This slice merged as e31e40c0a78dcdf99396ea8a0bf3648691416b35. The next valid WU-002 action is to port the already-verified secure CONNECT/DISCONNECT/QUERY_STATUS lifecycle from WDF request/file semantics to raw WDM IRP/PFILE_OBJECT semantics while preserving METHOD_BUFFERED exact-size validation, FILE_READ_ACCESS|FILE_WRITE_ACCESS enforcement, driver-created section ownership, retained object reference/system mapping, immutable CONNECT-time protocol geometry, requestor PID + exact file-object + session-generation fencing, status snapshots and cleanup teardown. Microsoft documentation confirms METHOD_BUFFERED uses Irp->AssociatedIrp.SystemBuffer, IoGetRequestorProcessId provides the originating PID, the cleanup IRP exposes its PFILE_OBJECT in the current stack location, and IoValidateDeviceIoControlAccess can enforce read/write access dynamically. This security port must remain disconnected from live DriverEntry until CI verified. Only then should live DriverEntry switch to PortCls primary ownership and install the raw WDM dispatch wrappers while StartDevice remains fail-closed. Actual wave/topology miniports, WaveRT stream scheduling bound to ConsumeOneRingFrame, INF/install/test-signing, endpoint enumeration, calling-app routing and controlled-hardware evidence remain pending. Paid provider usage, proprietary model training, production credentials/cloud spend and production deployment remain subject to applicable provider/data/compute/release gates.
